description.value: Simms Creek Greenway is a protected nature reserve greenway in the Campbell River area of Vancouver Island, situated within the region's salmon-bearing watershed landscape. The area falls within the mandate of Greenways Land Trust, a registered charity operating since 1996 that conserves ecological and recreational greenways on the traditional territories of the Wei Wai Kum, We Wai Kai, and Kwiakah First Nations. Touring cyclists in the Campbell River corridor may find it a scenic natural detour, though on-site facilities are unconfirmed.
